label: Teltonika TRM142
description: An industrial 2G/3G/4G Cat 4 modem with a single DB9 RS232 port, in a rugged DIN-rail case. It has no Ethernet and no radio of its own - it exists to put a serial device on a cellular network.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRM142 datasheet: one DB9 RS232 connector with RTS/CTS flow control; 2G/3G/4G LTE Cat 4, modelled at the 100 Mbps Cat 4 class shared with the RUT2xx routers. No Ethernet port exists on this device, so none is claimed - the RS232 connector is the only physical data interface and is modelled as a console interface.
